points.why: Names Accidental Adversaries, calls them natural allies, and describes how each side's local fix hurts the other.
Traces the full reinforcing loop from volume to weak candidates, more screening, slower fills and back to more volume.
States the tell explicitly: each side accurately narrates its own behavior as reasonable, and neither account explains the loop alone.
Recommends showing both groups the loop together and changing measures, including quality-adjusted time-to-fill, a joint intake and a signed scorecard.

pitfalls.why: Explicitly says neither side is right.
Frames them as allies under Accidental Adversaries, not as rivals in Escalation.
